ModMetaData.description:
SexSlaveCraft 2.3.2 (TieJin Modify) 训导官特化与调教稳定性。 基于上游 2.2.8 继续维护，包含 2.3.1 及更早版本内容。 新增代主人调教其他性奴的训导官特化，包含研究、培养、20% 任职资格、50% 熟练阶段、人格凝胶终极化和分阶段属性加成。 旧档性奴调教员开关一次性关闭，取得新资格后可重新开启；绑定、指派和历史进度保留。 优化绑定仪式选人，自动调教兼容 Education 课程，修复连续目标停滞、预约释放红字、终极化原料消耗及“未选择”显示，补齐四语文案。 旧 RimTalk 兼容继续暂停，宠物猫、宠物兔未完成入口继续禁用。 完整中英双语更新记录见 CHANGELOG.md。
Continues development from upstream 2.2.8, including 2.3.1 and earlier content. Adds Training Officers with research, progression, trainer eligibility at 20%, an experienced stage at 50%, personality-gel finalization and staged attribute bonuses. Old Sex Slave trainer toggles reset once; obtain eligibility and enable duty again. Bonds, assignments and progress remain. Improves binding ritual selection and optional Education compatibility; fixes consecutive Training, reservation errors, invalid finalization ingredients and Unset display, with four-language text. Legacy RimTalk remains suspended; unfinished Pet Cat and Pet Rabbit choices remain disabled. See CHANGELOG.md for the full Chinese and English notes.
